name: @hasna/browser
description: General-purpose browser agent toolkit — Playwright, Chrome DevTools Protocol, Lightpanda with auto engine selection. CLI + MCP + REST + SDK.

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:dashboard && bun run build:extension && bun run build:cli && bun run build:mcp && bun run build:server && bun run build:lib && bun run build:types
scripts.build:cli: bun build src/cli/index.tsx --outdir dist/cli --target bun --external ink --external react --external chalk --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk --external @anthropic-ai/sdk --external @onkernel/sdk --external @hasna/secrets --external playwright --external sharp --external @hasna/conversations --external @hasna/mementos --external @hasna/todos --external @hasna/skills
scripts.build:mcp: bun build src/mcp/index.ts --outdir dist/mcp --target bun --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk --external @anthropic-ai/sdk --external @onkernel/sdk --external @hasna/secrets --external playwright --external sharp --external @hasna/conversations --external @hasna/mementos --external @hasna/todos --external @hasna/skills
scripts.build:server: bun build src/server/index.ts --outdir dist/server --target bun --external @anthropic-ai/sdk --external @onkernel/sdk --external @hasna/secrets --external playwright --external sharp --external @hasna/conversations --external @hasna/mementos --external @hasna/todos --external @hasna/skills
scripts.build:lib: bun build src/index.ts src/storage.ts src/video.ts src/extension.ts --outdir dist --target bun --external playwright --external sharp --external @anthropic-ai/sdk --external @onkernel/sdk --external @hasna/secrets --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk --external @hasna/conversations --external @hasna/mementos --external @hasna/todos --external @hasna/skills
scripts.build:dashboard: cd dashboard && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build
scripts.build:extension: cd extension && ../node_modules/.bin/vite build && cp manifest.json dist/manifest.json && cp dist/src/popup/popup.html dist/popup.html && rm -rf dist/src
scripts.verify:release: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run scripts/verify-release.ts
scripts.postinstall: sh -c 'base="$HOME/.hasna/browser"; for dir in screenshots pdfs states downloads videos profiles persistent diffs exports recordings action-cache evidence scripts workflows workflows/evidence; do mkdir -p "$base/$dir"; done' 2>/dev/null || true
